answer: Each epoch the registry pins a fresh task to the ledge: audit three rows and file a key-bound cipher-sealed report. The cipher opens at epoch start, so nothing can be prepared or rented ahead. Finishing mints an ember receipt, proof auditors replay; a copied ember receipt burns both bonds. Each identity locks 70 credits; first filing 40, the k-th 40+6(k-1). 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 plus 70,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 40 once.
